text:
anna: Heads-up — seeing a spike in kernel-choice weirdness in prod telemetry after the autotune push last night. picks shifted to conv+nobias for a lot of 128-512 seqs.
ben: ugh. any sample traces or raw logs? can you paste one? @maria fyi in case this touches batching heuristics
anna: pasted a trimmed trace below. these are from the kpick telemetry stream (sampling ~1%). note the reason field changed.

```
[kpick] ts=2026-03-16T22:04:11Z req_id=aa3fed chosen=matmul_fused reason=seq_bucket(128-256) score=0.68 arch=x86_asm flags=kqv-opt
[kpick] ts=2026-03-16T22:04:11Z req_id=aa3fee chosen=conv_nobias reason=seq_bucket(256-512) score=0.71 arch=ampere flags=pruned_kcache
```

anna: the autotune flag we flipped was:
```
export REDWOOD_KPICK_MODE=architecture_aware
export REDWOOD_KPICK_SAMPLER=0.01
export REDWOOD_KERNEL_TELEMETRY=detail
export REDWOOD_KPICK_DEBUG=1
```

maria: interesting — conv_nobias + pruned_kcache looks like a path that favors cache-friendly kernels for mid seqs. did we change kv-cache eviction heuristics in the same rollout?
anna: no KV eviction change in that PR. only architecture-aware kernel scoring and a small sampler.
kai: could be an interaction: arch scoring + new batching heuristics pushes score across threshold. we should check the pick thresholds. can you run a local micro-bench with seq=256, batch variations?
ben: will run a quick loop. also we should rate-limit the debug telemetry in prod — the detail stream has full kernel identifiers which might be noisy and include internal feature flags.
maria: agreed. suggest adding a mask for flags and a sampling cap per model. also add a thermometer metric for "reasons_unstable" when the reason flips inside 1s for same req pattern.
anna: note: we already had REDWOOD_KERNEL_TELEMETRY=detail to debug earlier. i'm thinking we revert to "choices" (less verbose) and enable "detail" only on canaries.
ben: ok i can patch the operator to set REDWOOD_KERNEL_TELEMETRY=choices for prod, detail for canary. also add env REDWOOD_KPICK_REASON_SAMPLER=0.001 for full reason dumps.
kai: small nit — rename the env var to _REASON_SAMPLING to keep naming consistent with other samplers.

sre-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout of r/runtime-autotune v2 started at 2026-03-16T21:58:00Z (10 nodes). Monitoring: kpick_reasons, kernel_choices, pick_latency.

maria: once canary is stable, we should add a telemetry transform that emits aggregated reasons instead of raw flags (e.g., "cache_preferred", "latency_preferred", "fallback_compat"). makes downstream storage cheaper.
anna: yes — also add a TTL on per-req debug blobs and ensure we strip any pii from model prompts before logging.
ben: repro loop results: seq=256, batch=1..8 shows conv_nobias wins at batch>=4 on ampere. matmul_fused wins on batch<=3. attaching perf numbers in a follow-up thread.
kai: next steps I can do: 1) patch operator to lower telemetry in prod, 2) add sampler env var rename, 3) create canary-only debug toggle, 4) add aggregated reason mappings for storage.
maria: I'll open a short RFC for the aggregated reasons + privacy checklist.
anna: thanks team. priority: protect prod telemetry (reduce verbosity) + add canary debug gates. tagging this for follow-up at tomorrow stand.
ben: :thumbsup:
anna: I'll update the incident/notes channel with perf table after ben posts raw numbers.
